secondary_refit_recommendation.rule: Do not automatically replace hair/cloth/tail pivots with all centroid samples. Narrow parent-child blend regions may guide manual refit; wide separated clouds indicate multiple garment regions and are unsuitable as a joint center.
secondary_refit_recommendation.warning: Original geometry is already asymmetrically posed. Changing armature rest matrices while retaining geometry and weights rebinds the visible pose, but cannot recover original unposed anatomy exactly.

orientation_recommendation.anatomical_chain_tails: Use next joint head as main bone tail: humerus->elbow, forearm->wrist, thigh->knee, shin->ankle, each finger segment->next knuckle.
orientation_recommendation.roll: For humerus and forearm, align a local transverse axis with the plane through shoulder/elbow/wrist. For legs, use hip/knee/ankle plane; keep consistent sign per side. Blender local Y must point toward child. Roll is not recoverable exactly from skin clouds.
orientation_recommendation.terminal_fingers: Use direction from last knuckle toward distal weighted cloud centroid, with original distal phalanx length or visible fingertip bounds. Do not use original world X directions.
orientation_recommendation.evaluation: Candidate refit needs explicit moderate and extreme bending tests, including neighboring twist groups, and face/garment intersection review. No automatic anatomical-quality guarantee.
